Stable GitHub launcher fingerprint
nodes.rationale: The launcher fingerprint changes only with its entrypoint or channel; remote DS and workflow changes do not require reinstalling.

nodes.label: Commit-coherent GitHub work session
nodes.rationale: A new job resolves main again while the active job preserves one commit and its evidence.

nodes.label: On-demand verified source retrieval
nodes.rationale: The reduced Graphify index selects the original sources and their hashes instead of requiring the complete corpus.

nodes.label: GitHub-only Figma invocation
nodes.rationale: The launcher resolves the current SHA and reads the complete Figma workflow and references at that commit.

nodes.label: GitHub-only PO invocation
nodes.rationale: The launcher resolves the current SHA and reads the complete PO workflow and references at that commit.

nodes.label: Official DS control provenance
nodes.rationale: A public web export or linked Figma instance, mapped to the brief, demonstrates reuse rather than visual resemblance.

nodes.label: Linear Progress must remain an official component
nodes.rationale: Progress is consumed as Linear Progress rather than a handmade native or graphical substitute.

nodes.label: Product molecules only
nodes.rationale: Local work builds modules, cards and sections from product content and official controls without extending the atomic DS.

nodes.label: Atomic coverage gaps block the affected scope
nodes.rationale: A functional exception may justify a molecule but cannot authorize an atom or imitation.

nodes.label: Exact component Body namespace
nodes.rationale: Product content uses component/body roles while official components retain their internal token chains.

nodes.label: AppShell required for every product screen and state
nodes.rationale: The host preserves the official navigation, regions and behavior instead of a local shell imitation.

nodes.label: Molecules occupy the AppShell Body slot
nodes.rationale: The composition keeps the host regions and component dependencies aligned with their contracts.

nodes.label: Conversation host configuration
nodes.rationale: Chat lives in the conversation Body and tools occupy the corresponding right-side region with Rail and Panel behavior.

nodes.label: Figma runtime obtained from GitHub
nodes.rationale: Tools and templates are read at the pinned commit and verified without executing an installed engine.

nodes.label: Exhaustive Figma family tracking
nodes.rationale: Every family receives an applicability reason and applicable uses receive source identities and final readback.

nodes.label: Linked component typography preservation
nodes.rationale: Custom content follows Body while linked components preserve their native metrics, ranges and bindings.

nodes.label: Actual Figma identity preflight
nodes.rationale: The plan binds a verified source node and actual component key before constructing the prototype.

nodes.label: Body binding readback
nodes.rationale: The collector records variable name, collection and property so the final gate can verify canonical Body consumption.

nodes.label: Readback scope limits
nodes.rationale: Presence of bound fields alone does not prove semantic role, aliases, values or modes.

nodes.label: Body molecule construction boundary
nodes.rationale: Functional exceptions permit composition of official pieces and never substitute inaccessible DS atoms.

nodes.label: Variable content requires a real Slot
nodes.rationale: A named frame, fixed instance swaps or auto layout do not prove an extensible native Slot.

nodes.label: Self-contained Markdown handoff
nodes.rationale: The embedded structured JSON is sufficient input when it contains the necessary sources, identities and layout.

nodes.label: Source hash compatibility across cuts
nodes.rationale: Different versions require comparison of all used sources and dependencies rather than accepting a matching component name.

nodes.label: No inferred execution evidence
nodes.rationale: A screenshot cannot prove bindings and an executed write cannot prove complete conformance.

nodes.label: Graph-directed AppShell dependencies
nodes.rationale: The host dependency query locates Header, Sidebar, amendments and Section Header before the composition is built.

nodes.label: Conversation AppShell and Chat capture coverage
nodes.rationale: Both mapped official instances must be present in each captured conversation state.

nodes.label: Plan before prototype implementation
nodes.rationale: The complete family and per-control map is verified before writing prototype code.

nodes.label: Offline product HTML validation
nodes.rationale: The final HTML is validated by file URL with HTTP and HTTPS blocked.

nodes.label: Body does not replace internal component tokens
nodes.rationale: Custom product composition uses Body while official components keep their own aliases and typography.

nodes.label: Exact web dependencies and isolated work folders
nodes.rationale: The GitHub tool creates a new runtime and project; compatible dependencies can be reused for tests without global installation.

nodes.label: Embedded assets include later interaction states
nodes.rationale: The transform maps JSX media to local data URIs so delayed UI remains portable.

nodes.label: Browser QA does not require a server
nodes.rationale: Playwright opens an isolated HTML with blocked network and checks hydration, fonts, assets, geometry and behavior.

nodes.label: State recipes start from a clean load
nodes.rationale: Independent state captures only prove transitions actually included in their action recipes.

nodes.label: Per-component native typography
nodes.rationale: Font family, weight, size, line height, spacing and decoration come from the component contract and delegated implementation.

nodes.label: Product typography uses Body roles
nodes.rationale: The custom content consumes the current Body typography and reports coverage gaps.

nodes.label: Web family target restrictions
nodes.rationale: Figma-only families remain handoff references and cannot be declared as public web components.

nodes.label: Verified public export is the DSNode direct child
nodes.rationale: Build-time binding resolution proves component provenance even under import aliases.

nodes.label: Product molecule Body property map
nodes.rationale: The local molecule records its type, host, Body slot, official dependencies and Body variables per property.

nodes.label: Typed Figma molecule plan
nodes.rationale: The Figma consumer records host usage, molecule owner and actual Body property bindings.

nodes.label: No cross-job cache fallback
nodes.rationale: Each workflow queries the reduced index and fetches required GitHub sources with identity and hash verification.
